summary: First-finish smoke test for CELL Command Center (UI-only demo). Home renders with THE MAP IS THE TRUTH hero, DEMO banner, and Command Center container. All 9 left-nav routes navigate and their page containers are visible. Master Map renders SVG canvas, node click updates the Context Inspector, filter buttons are clickable. Operations mission click works. Governance Approve/Block shows toast messages (3 approval rows detected). Elite Teams shows 6 team panels and agent click works. Command palette opens via Cmd+K and global search trigger. Conversation panel accepts input, returns keyword-matched reply for 'map', and minimize hides it. No page errors; only a benign Radix a11y warning about missing DialogTitle inside CommandPalette DialogContent.
